Prepare an incidence matrix from an interaction table

Source: R/prepare_incidence_matrix.R
prepare_incidence_matrix.Rd

Builds an incidence (presence/absence) matrix from a two-column data.frame of species interactions.

Usage

prepare_incidence_matrix(db)

Arguments

db

A data.frame with exactly two columns (e.g., parasite and host).

Value

An incidence matrix (rows = first column unique values, cols = second column unique values) filled with 0/1.

Examples

prepare_incidence_matrix(beetleTreeInteractions)
